material.description: The fix for hero-icon-404s-missing-15-skinned-png (170627de) added a hardcoded missingIcons list in moba_ui.json, read by hero_icon (panels.lua) and the image resolver (play.js). hy3d has since copied the full set (57 icons, origin b11eea99, 167 hero PNGs), so those 15 heroes now show a text label instead of a portrait. Change: remove the missingIcons block, its use in hero_icon and in the resolver. Acceptance: no missingIcons reference left; hero_icon returns the image for every hero with a model; CI green on the pushed sha; the live census still shows zero hero-icon 404s.

material.subject: Revert the missingIcons list: all 167 hero icons are on origin, so the list hides 15 present portraits
material.witness: Same-origin lobby page load on the live Pages site after publish 3d5c3fe5 (session verify-network-404-witness-4): 72 requests, the only failure is the deliberate missing-script probe; no hero-icon 404. ci run for 3d5c3fe5 is green. The missingIcons list is removed from moba_ui.json, panels.lua and play.js. Portraits are not visually checked here.
